plugins.description: Brief to rendered MP4 in one video format: hard cuts, giant kinetic type, a terminal that types real commands, audio-reactive waveforms, and ElevenLabs narration with an emotion preset per objective. Ships deterministic seek adapters for GSAP, Anime.js, Motion and Lottie.
